moments.title: Football Season Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The new Premier League and EFL Championship seasons are kicking off this weekend, bringing top-tier football back to grounds across the UK.

angles.name: Excitement
angles.copy: The wait is over! The Premier League and Championship seasons are officially kicking off this weekend. Who are you backing for glory?

angles.name: Fan Buzz
angles.copy: New season, new hopes! Football is back across the UK this weekend. What's your matchday ritual?

moments.title: Green Man Festival Begins!
moments.blurb: Green Man Festival, one of Wales' most beloved independent music and arts festivals, takes place in the Brecon Beacons from August 18-21.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons are about to come alive! Green Man Festival kicks off on Tuesday with an incredible line-up of music, arts, and good vibes. Who's heading to Wales?

angles.name: Welsh Event
angles.copy: It's almost time for Green Man! Our beautiful Welsh mountains will host thousands of festival-goers from Tuesday. Are you ready for the magic?

moments.title: UK Chart No.1: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean hold the Official UK Singles Chart number one with 'Rein Me In' for a record-breaking 21st non-consecutive week, while Madonna and Kylie Minogue debut in the Top 10.

angles.name: Chart Toppers
angles.copy: Still at number one! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' makes it a record 21 weeks at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart! Huge congrats!

angles.name: Pop Legends
angles.copy: Queens of Pop unite! Madonna and Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' has debuted in the Official UK Top 10! What a collaboration!

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays Roll On
moments.blurb: The UK is still firmly in the swing of summer holidays, with many families enjoying their last weeks off before schools return.

angles.name: Summer Fun
angles.copy: Still making the most of the summer holidays? Whether it's staycations or adventures abroad, enjoy these last weeks of freedom!

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: The summer holidays are slowly winding down for many across the UK. What's been your favourite summer memory so far?

moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Countdown
moments.blurb: The last bank holiday of the summer is approaching fast, with the UK set for a long weekend on Monday, August 31st.

angles.name: Long Weekend Anticipation
angles.copy: Counting down to the last long weekend of summer! The August Bank Holiday is just over two weeks away – how are you planning to spend it?

angles.name: Planning Ahead
angles.copy: Don't forget: the Summer Bank Holiday is on August 31st! Time to start making those plans for a well-deserved extra day off.
